trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

- **Diagnosis**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate and failing health checks. Release history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production.
- **Rollback**: Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
- **Verification**: Confirmed checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with an error rate dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.
